message.content:
I don’t have real‑time clock access, so I can’t give you the exact current time right now.  
If you need the precise time in New York City, you can check a reliable source such as:

* Your phone’s world clock or time‑zone app  
* A web search for “current time in New York”  
* A time‑zone converter like [timeanddate.com](https://www.timeanddate.com) or the built‑in “World Clock” feature on most operating systems  

As a quick reference: New York City is in the Eastern Time Zone (UTC‑5 during standard time, UTC‑4 during daylight‑saving time). In late August it is on Eastern Daylight Time (UTC‑4). So if you know the current UTC time, subtract 4 hours to get the local time in New York.
